caveats.statement: Card power can be NULL or '*' meaning no power; queries must handle both.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb004 WHERE cl0143 IS NULL OR cl0143 = '*';

caveats.statement: YearMonth is stored as YYYYMM string; year is first 4 chars, month is last 2 chars.
Driver full name is split across forename (cl0255) and surname (cl0256); concatenate for full name.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT cl0255, cl0256 FROM tb025 LIMIT 5;

caveats.statement: Race date is in cl0261; use MONTH() and YEAR() for filtering by month/year.
Some cards have missing or degraded properties/values flagged by cl0110=1, so property-based filters may exclude them
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb004 WHERE cl0110 = 1

caveats.statement: Card language is stored in a separate table (tb005), so joining is required to filter by language
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb005 WHERE cl0163 = 'French'

caveats.statement: Banned status is per play format in tb006, so a card may be banned in one format but legal in another
caveats.check_sql: SELECT cl0164, COUNT(*) FROM tb006 WHERE cl0165 = 'Banned' GROUP BY cl0164

caveats.statement: Account region and issuance type both use cl0211 in tb019, so filters must be applied carefully to avoid conflating them
caveats.check_sql: SELECT cl0211, COUNT(*) FROM tb019 GROUP BY cl0211

caveats.statement: Client category codes SME/LAM/KAM live in tb011.cl0185, not in the client table; must join
Race completion is encoded by non-null finish time, not by a status flag.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT(cl0262) AS completed FROM tb027

caveats.statement: Fundraising notes are tied to a type code and date; filtering only by date may return multiple rows.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT cl0319, cl0320, COUNT(*) FROM tb042 GROUP BY cl0319, cl0320
